descriptionChirho: The open land or common surrounding a Levitical city designated for grazing livestock, used predominantly in the allotment lists of Joshua and Chronicles.
Unbuilt open ground or vacant area adjacent to a settlement, emphasizing the absence of structures rather than the pastoral use.
A verbal reading (Qal infinitive of grš) meaning to drive out or expel, likely a parsing variant or homographic confusion with the noun migrāš.
